text: ava: quick sketch: put a vertical heatband on the left (density by hour/day) and token breakdown cards stacked to the right. add a "compact mode" toggle that reduces charts to icons for cramped screens. question: where do invoices live? per-row PDF icon, header "Export" dropdown, or a small pinned "Invoices" sidebar? figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzzz/vertical-band-compact-mode diego: vertical band is neat for scanning across projects. mobile worry: left column eats horizontal space on phones. compact mode could default on mobile. :iphone: rachel: discoverability: finance folks expect a per-project download. ops folks prefer bulk export. Suggest: show a low-contrast row PDF icon (secondary) + header Export (primary) with dropdown: PDF, CSV, XLSX. Keep pin as a less-visible beta feature. tom: UX tradeoff: per-row icon increases visual noise in dense lists. Might hide it behind hover on desktop and inside kebab menu on mobile. keyboard shortcut idea: allow power users to press D when a row is focused to download invoice for that project. lia: accessibility thread: color-dependent heatband needs redundant encoding (pattern/hatch) and an aria-describedby that reads peaks. contrast must meet 4.5:1 for any text overlay. keyboard order should be: header Export -> compact toggle -> heatband -> token cards. If we add a shortcut (D), document it in the accessibility notes and ensure it doesn't conflict with screen-reader shortcuts. ava: copy suggestion: rename card header from "Tokens" to "Consumed tokens" or "Token usage"? Also add a tiny cost-per-token tooltip: "$0.0008 / token (avg)". diego: for mobile collapse: each card becomes an accordion with summary line (project name, total tokens, small sparkline). tapping expands details + download action. Keep header export accessible via sticky top bar. rachel: CSV vs PDF debate: CSV useful for analysts, PDF for accounting records. default header Export -> PDF and a secondary "Download CSV" option. track which is used more. :bar_chart: tom: small code snippet for screen-reader label for the row download: ```html ``` lia: also provide a verbose aria-live region for bulk exports so a screen reader announces export started/completed. Example: `div aria-live="polite" id="export-status">Export started for 3 invoices...`. We'll test NVDA + VoiceOver on the prototype. ava: metrics to track for A/B: time-to-download (task completion), #support tickets asking "where are invoices", export format distribution, clicks on per-row vs header export. Run experiment for 2 weeks. diego: A/B variants: A = header Export + per-row icon (desktop hover, kebab on mobile). B = header Export only + per-row item in row kebab always. Measure clicks-per-task and error/retry. rachel: tiny UX ask: in compact mode show an affordance to switch back to full mode (text link) and surface quick cost totals in the header. figma-bot: Uploaded frame "Vertical band + compact" with pages: desktop / tablet / mobile. Prototype links: desktop:https://www.figma.com/proto/xxxxx/vertical-desktop mobile:https://www.figma.com/proto/xxxxx/vertical-mobile lia: I'll run an a11y checklist once prototype is in figma. I'll test keyboard order, screen-reader labels, color contrast, and the aria-live behavior. ava: thanks team. diego + rachel, can you produce the two prototypes (A/B) by Wed EOD? lia will queue a11y passes. we'll review metrics after 2 weeks and pick default. :thumbsup:
